Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You speak a familiar word and hold their gaze until the world begins to settle around them.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
One adjacent willing creature
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Pay the printed action and any full activity time for each use.
Type
Recovery

Choose an eligible willing creature and roll Reason. Reduce its temporary Dazed by the amount below, to a minimum of 0. This restores no HP. A persistent condition marked with an asterisk requires the treatment or remedy stated by its source.

Weak
Reduce Dazed by 1.
Standard
Reduce Dazed by 2.
Strong
Reduce Dazed by 3.
